d:
Three years of Zero1byZerodha
Somewhere along the way, we started wondering:
Is any of this actually making a difference?
So for Teacher’s Day, we decided to ask you.
Has Zero1 ever helped you make a financial decision? Changed the way you think about money? Made you sit down with your family and have a conversation you otherwise wouldn't have had?
We got some incredible stories back. People who changed their buying decisions after watching a video. Families who started talking about money together. Young people who started investing. And plenty of feedback on what we could do better.
